clue.text: Bad girl at ease dancing round piano in 27 20 events?

parts.note: ill means bad, as in ill luck or ill will

explanation.surface: A wayward girl, dancing at ease, gets wrapped round a piano at some do in Downing Street.

explanation.definitionFit: Gatherings held at Number 10 during lockdown broke the rules, so the 'events' there were unlawful get-togethers.

explanation.definitionFit: To irk is to annoy, so something irking is causing annoyance.
